title: M14 Comprehensive Review: context / learnings / memory

findings.description: memory.ts writeAll() non-atomic write: backup→main→delete. Crash between backup write and main write loses both old and new data. Should use temp-file + atomic rename.
AC-08/AC-09: pipeline integration (createFeature/continue auto-save context) has no dedicated integration test. Verified only indirectly via full regression
context.ts loadContext.updatedAt uses new Date() instead of reading timestamp from CONTEXT.md file
learnings.ts addLearning() has no input validation — empty category/title/description produce malformed markdown
memory.ts deleteMemory() lacks activity audit logging unlike writeMemory which does
context.ts parseMarkdownSections fragile to ## inside content blocks (e.g. code blocks in nextAction description)
ARCHITECTURE.md not updated to reflect 3 new orchestrator submodules

code_quality.note: All AC met. 129/129 tests green. FR-1 (non-atomic write) is only functional risk
100% follows DESIGN Option A. Matches existing checkpoint/logger patterns
14 new tests cover core paths. Pipeline integration and activity audit lack explicit tests
Modules under 150 LOC each, clean interfaces, well-documented exports
No new attack surface. Paths based on process.cwd(). Backup fallback for data integrity
CHANGELOG updated. ARCHITECTURE.md missing new modules

summary: Comprehensive 5-round review complete: 1 major (non-atomic write), 1 medium (missing integration test), 5 minor. All findings documented with file:line references. 7.8/10 — approved with follow-up recommendation for FR-1.
